exposure: Direct obstetric causes (hypertensive disorders, obstetric hemorrhage, thromboembolism)
Indirect obstetric causes (severe anemia, jaundice, heart disease)
cohort: The study cohort comprised 1,75,128 deliveries and 1194 maternal deaths recorded at MGM and MTH Hospital in Indore, India, from January 2013 to December 2023.
finding: The study found an average Maternal Mortality Ratio of 960.5 per 100,000 live births, with a majority of deaths (59.9%) occurring in referred cases from peripheral health centers and during the postnatal period, primarily due to direct (64.8%) and indirect (27.3%) obstetric causes.
